verdict.rationale: The evidence shows building blocks rather than a liability view. Transactions are jurisdiction-aware and can be listed and retrieved with filters, and AI analysis can explain jurisdiction breakdowns. Return preparation and VAT report aggregation exist only as separate add-on products (Managed Returns, VAT Reporting), and the community notes AvaTax covers collection but filing must be handled separately. missing for 10: an accrued-liability-by-jurisdiction report, a collected-versus-owed reconciliation view, filing-ready detail within AvaTax itself, exports in formats an accountant or GL can consume, and independent hands-on corroboration.
